description:
AliExpress product data: search with price, shipping and Choice filters, product details, reviews, shipping options to a country, image search, store details and store products, category tree, hot products and SuperDeals.

Operations (set "operation" to one of these; put its parameters in "args"):
- search (required: query): Search
- product_details (required: product_id): Product Details
- product_reviews (required: product_id): Product Reviews
- shipping_options (required: product_id): Shipping Options
- categories (no required params): Categories
- image_search (required: image_url): Image Search
- store_details (required: store_id): Store Details
- store_products (required: store_id): Store Products
- hot_products (no required params): Hot Products
- deals (no required params): Deals

When to use: Use for AliExpress specifically. For Amazon use realtime_amazon_data; for cross-retailer comparison use realtime_product_search.

args.description: Parameters for the chosen operation as key/value pairs (see the tool description for required params).

operation.description: Which endpoint to call. See the tool description for each operation and its parameters.

name: realtime_aliexpress_data
